headline: Three replies from Saturday are still untouched three days on, and Monday is logged twice in the daily log.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Work Alexander Cano, Jack trades and Leppan before anything else. They replied Saturday night and nothing has been logged against them since, which is three days against a speed to lead rule that has already produced three same hour bookings. Then close the four open call outcomes: Robert, luca, Evan and Joshua Haber. Six working days left and EUR 5,000 of 30,000 collected, so those four names are the entire month.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: The daily log now has two rows dated Aug 24, one at 36 initials and one at 31, and the metrics tab is adding both. One of them is wrong, and every rate on the sheet runs off that inflated total until it is fixed.
